tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Warm cream in light, night ink in dark.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs and panels that sit on `surface`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body and heading text on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `brand-tint`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (suburb line, helper text) on `surface` and `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative 1px hairlines between cards and sections. Never the only cue for a control.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, chips and secondary buttons. At least 3:1 on `surface` and `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The coral heart in the mark. Fills and graphics, and text only at 24px or larger (or bold 19px+). Never body-size text, and never the ground behind the mark.

tokens.name: brand-text
tokens.usage: Coral for small text and links on `surface` and `surface-raised`: 5.3:1 in light, 6.1:1 in dark.

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: Soft coral ground for photo placeholders and notices. Text on it is `ink`.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Fill of the primary button and selected chips. Text on it is `on-action`.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `action`: 5.3:1 in light, 6.1:1 in dark.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Cupid's arrow, highlights and the pending status. Never a text colour on light grounds (1.8:1 on `surface`).

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `gold`.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: solid 2px with a 2px offset. At least 3:1 on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: status-live
tokens.usage: Approved, live profiles. Always paired with the word Live and a check icon.

tokens.name: status-rejected
tokens.usage: Needs-changes and takedown notices. Always paired with the words Needs changes and an alert icon.

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: Fixed dark ground for logo panels and the app icon, the same in both themes.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Fixed cream used for the bicep in the mark and for light logo panels, the same in both themes.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Wordmark and hero headlines. Always sentence case or the exact wordmark.

styles.name: body-l
styles.usage: About you and looking-for text on a profile.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default text and form input text.

styles.name: body-s
styles.usage: Helper text, suburb line, secondary lb values.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, chips, badges and field labels.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Small uppercase section labels, such as BENCH above a lift.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside chips and badges.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gaps between related fields.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap and input padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding and section gaps.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gaps between groups of cards.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Page margins on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Large section breaks.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges and small tiles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs and lift tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Profile cards and panels.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: App icon corners and large cover blocks.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Quick-pick chips.
